# Origin Pro MCP

The `origin-pro-mcp/` directory contains the upstream Python package, package metadata, README and MIT license at [commit 1e9741af96c45bcac9e619c3ba32264bac6950e7](https://github.com/youngminsw/Origin-Pro-MCP/tree/1e9741af96c45bcac9e619c3ba32264bac6950e7). The vendored files retain their original contents. Tests, repository history and development notes are available at that commit.

The bundled Windows backend uses the wheel built from these files. Its SHA-256 is `3e1a1747f8c8b77bf9c24115287bba816714b60591c6565c1c5df04aa8cca7f8`. This commit declares version 0.3.1. The similarly named PyPI release available during packaging is 0.1.0.

The upstream binary wheel is platform-neutral Python code. Its real Origin automation requires Windows, a compatible registered Origin installation and licensing. Origin itself is installed separately.
